test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following sportspersons was NOT awarded the Arjuna Award in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arpinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arpinder Singh** was NOT awarded the Arjuna Award in 2022.
 
• **Arpinder Singh** secured a **Gold Medal for India **in the Men's triple jump event at the Asian Games in Jakarta, marking the end of a 48-year hiatus since India last achieved this feat.
 
• The previous champion was Mohinder Singh Gill in 1970.
 
• Prior to his victory in Jakarta, Arpinder's most recent medal was a bronze in the 2014 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow.
 
• **Lakshya Sen, Sushila Devi and HS Prannoy** were awarded the Arjuna Award in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Lakshya Sen** is a prominent Indian badminton player, having previously held the title of world junior no. 1. He achieved gold medals at the 2018 Asian Junior Championships in the boys' singles category and at the Summer Youth Olympics in the mixed team event.
 
• **Shushila Devi Likmabam** represents India in judo and earned the silver medal in the women's 48 kg weight class at the judo event during the 2014 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
 
• **Prannoy Haseena Sunil Kumar,** also known as H. S. Prannoy, is an accomplished Indian badminton player who is currently undergoing training at the Gopichand Badminton Academy in Hyderabad. His notable achievements include winning the bronze medal at the 2023 World Championships.
